content.title: Product / SKU Catalog
content.tldr: Each store maintains a catalog of products. Every product has a unique SKU, a display name, a price in VNĐ (integer, no decimals), and a VAT rate. Only admin and store-manager can manage products. Cashiers can read/search products to build an order.
content.summary: Quản lý danh mục sản phẩm của từng cửa hàng. Mỗi sản phẩm có mã SKU duy nhất, tên hiển thị, giá bán bằng VNĐ (số nguyên), và thuế suất VAT. Quản lý và admin có thể tạo/sửa/xóa sản phẩm. Thu ngân chỉ có quyền đọc và tìm kiếm sản phẩm khi lập đơn hàng.

conditions: You only need the Product entity shape — read entity-registry.json
You are working on Order and only need the product FK — read api-contracts/product.json

do_not: Do NOT store price as float/decimal — always integer VNĐ
Do NOT expose products from other stores
Do NOT allow hard-delete — soft deactivation only (isActive=false)
Do NOT allow VAT rate outside supported values: 0, 5, 8, 10 (percent)
see_also: wiki/features/order.json → Product is referenced by OrderItem

items.i_want: to create a new product with SKU, name, price, and VAT rate
items.so_that: cashiers can select it when processing a sale
acceptance_criteria: Given valid sku, name, priceVnd, taxRatePercent — When POST /api/v1/products by manager/admin — Then 201 with product object
Given SKU already exists in this store — When POST /api/v1/products — Then 409 'SKU already exists in this store'
Given SKU exists in a DIFFERENT store — When POST /api/v1/products — Then 201 (SKU uniqueness is per-store)
Given priceVnd < 0 — When POST /api/v1/products — Then 400 'Price must be a positive integer'
Given priceVnd is a decimal (e.g. 1000.5) — When POST /api/v1/products — Then 400
Given taxRatePercent not in [0, 5, 8, 10] — When POST /api/v1/products — Then 400 'Invalid VAT rate'
Given caller is cashier or viewer — When POST /api/v1/products — Then 403
edge_cases: name contains Vietnamese diacritics — stored as-is, returned as-is
Very long name (> 255 chars) — 400 validation error
business_rules: BR-PROD-01: priceVnd is always an integer representing đồng. No sub-đồng values.
BR-PROD-02: taxRatePercent allowed values: 0, 5, 8, 10 (matching Vietnamese VAT tiers)
BR-PROD-03: SKU uniqueness is scoped per store — same SKU can exist in different stores
BR-PROD-04: isActive defaults to true on creation

items.i_want: to update a product's name, price, or VAT rate
acceptance_criteria: Given valid productId and updated fields — When PATCH /api/v1/products/:id — Then 200 with updated product
Given SKU included in body — When PATCH /api/v1/products/:id — Then 400 'SKU cannot be changed after creation'
Given product not in caller's store — When PATCH /api/v1/products/:id — Then 404 (not 403 — do not leak cross-store existence)
Given cashier calls PATCH — Then 403
edge_cases: Price change on a product that has open orders in 'pending' state — allowed. OrderItem stores price snapshot at time of order creation, so historical orders are not affected.
business_rules: BR-PROD-05: SKU is immutable after creation
BR-PROD-06: Price changes do NOT retroactively affect existing order items (price is snapshotted on OrderItem)

items.i_want: to deactivate a product that is no longer sold
items.so_that: cashiers cannot add it to new orders
acceptance_criteria: Given valid productId — When PATCH /api/v1/products/:id/deactivate — Then 200, isActive=false
Given product already deactivated — Then 200 (idempotent)
Given cashier calls deactivate — Then 403
Given product not in caller's store — Then 404
edge_cases: Deactivated product referenced by open orders in 'pending' state — order is NOT cancelled. Product deactivation only prevents new orders from adding it.
business_rules: BR-PROD-07: Deactivated products are invisible to cashier product search
BR-PROD-08: Deactivated products remain visible to manager/admin for audit

items.i_want: to search for a product by name or SKU
items.so_that: I can quickly find what the customer wants to buy
acceptance_criteria: Given a query string — When GET /api/v1/products?q=... — Then 200 with matching active products from caller's store
Given empty query — When GET /api/v1/products — Then 200 with all active products (paginated, page size 20)
Given q matches SKU exactly — product appears first in results
Given q is partial name match (e.g. 'bánh') — products with 'bánh' in name are returned (case-insensitive, diacritic-insensitive via unaccent)
Given cashier from store A — Then results NEVER include products from store B
edge_cases: Vietnamese input with or without diacritics: searching 'banh my' should match 'Bánh Mì' — requires pg_trgm + unaccent extension
No results found — 200 with empty array (not 404)
business_rules: BR-PROD-09: Cashier search returns only isActive=true products
BR-PROD-10: Search is store-scoped — storeId filter mandatory
BR-PROD-11: Diacritic-insensitive search using unaccent PostgreSQL extension (already in entity-registry required extensions)

items.i_want: to view a product's full details by ID
items.so_that: I can confirm price and VAT before adding to an order
acceptance_criteria: Given valid productId in caller's store — When GET /api/v1/products/:id — Then 200 with full product
Given productId not in caller's store — Then 404
Given product is deactivated — cashier gets 404; manager/admin gets 200 with isActive: false
business_rules: Role-based visibility: deactivated products hidden from cashier, visible to manager+

sections.heading: Business Rules — Consolidated
items: BR-PROD-01: priceVnd is always integer đồng — no decimals
BR-PROD-06: Price changes do not affect historical OrderItems
BR-PROD-07: Deactivated products invisible to cashier search
BR-PROD-08: Deactivated products visible to manager/admin
BR-PROD-09: Cashier search — active products only
BR-PROD-10: All product queries scoped by storeId from JWT
BR-PROD-11: Search uses unaccent for Vietnamese diacritic-insensitive matching

items.question: Is a product's tax rate locked once it is referenced by an order?
items.decision: No — tax rate is snapshotted on OrderItem at order creation time. Product tax rate can change without affecting past orders.

items.question: Do we need product categories/tags?
items.default_decision: Flat list for MVP. No categories.

items.question: Should manager be able to bulk-import products via CSV?
